description: Count invocation-like statements within Manager.Run() by inspecting Statement nodes under the function.
strategy:
MATCH (p:Project {name:'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(:File)-[:CONTAINS]->(fn:Function {name:'Run'})
MATCH (fn)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Statement)
WHERE s.statement_type='expression_statement' AND s.text CONTAINS '('
RETURN count(s) AS invocationStatements;

description: Drill into Block nodes inside Manager.Run() to count all contained call-style statements in nested scopes.
strategy:
MATCH (p:Project {name:'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(:File)-[:CONTAINS]->(fn:Function {name:'Run'})
MATCH (fn)-[:CONTAINS]->(b:Block)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Statement)
WHERE s.text =~ '.*\w+\s*\(.*\).*'
RETURN count(s) AS callsInBlocks;

description: Include calls made by any local functions defined inside Manager.Run() to get a complete count of all method calls in its scope.
strategy:
MATCH (p:Project {name:'HelloWorldApp'})-[:CONTAINS]->(:File)-[:CONTAINS]->(parent:Function {name:'Run'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (parent)-[:CALLS]->(c1:Function)
OPTIONAL MATCH (parent)-[:CONTAINS]->(local:Function)-[:CALLS]->(c2:Function)
RETURN parent.name AS function, count(c1)+count(c2) AS totalCallsIncludingNested;
